issues.issue: MECHANISM-INERT conjunct 'D_zero routing is constant' is false by construction: NoisyTopkRouter_Cluster adds randn*softplus(s) noise before top-1, also at eval, so uniform s => uniformly random expert per row (two router calls agree 6.4% at E=16, chance 6.25%). Verdict unreachable as written.

issues.issue: D_orth is not a working-mechanism arm: router noise (std~softplus(1/E)) swamps spread of s; P(top1==argmax s) 0.056-0.085 at E=16 (chance 0.0625); with top_k=1 gate weight is always 1 so s gets no forecast-loss gradient. Null between D_zero and D_orth is close to built in.
